Who’s speaking

## The exec leadership you’ll hear from.

![Michael Azevedo](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fwebinar-registration%2Fmichael-azevedo-exec.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Michael Azevedo

VP, Sales · interface.ai

Michael brings over a decade of frontline banking experience at Union Bank and U.S. Bank, followed by a pivotal role at SavvyMoney where he scaled a national sales organization for financial institutions. At interface.ai, he leads all sales functions with a singular focus – ensuring every community bank & credit union has the tools to compete in an AI world.

![Bryan Dooley](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fwebinar-registration%2Fbryan-dooley.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Bryan Dooley

SVP, Customer Experience · interface.ai

Bryan has spent his career building customer success and solutions organizations across the tech space – including VP, Solutions at Vymo and 8+ years at Glia as SVP of Customer Solutions, where he built one of the most respected customer success teams in the industry. At interface.ai, he owns the entire client journey, from implementation through long-term ROI.

![Srinivas Njay](https://interface.ai/_next/image?url=%2Flp%2Fwebinar-registration%2Fsrinivas-exec.webp&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_7SxGrS45vF4fFWZRZ8Y3SLx57Chc)

### Srinivas Njay

CEO & Co-Founder · interface.ai

Srinivas brings a rare combination of deep credit union expertise and enterprise AI experience – including his time at Microsoft – that sits at the heart of everything interface.ai builds. He’s been developing AI for community banks and credit unions for 10+ years, and today leads the company’s vision to make agentic AI the operating standard for FIs.
